_comment: Manual corrections to mod source URLs, applied by scrape/scrape_mods.py on
every run so they survive re-scrapes. Key = Forge mod id (the "id" field
in data/mods.json). Use this when a mod's listed repo is dead, moved, or
wrong. The correction is added in front of the original rather than
replacing it, since a dead link still records where a mod used to live.
Delete an entry to fall back to whatever the Forge reports.

1277.note: Forge listed dev.sp-tarkov.com, which shut down and now redirects to github.com/sp-tarkov. Repointed to the actively maintained server mod (pushed 2026-08-03). An older mirror also exists at WelcomeToThursday/head-and-voice-selector (2024-12-02).
